propositions: Expected and auto-handled tickets-branch push failures (contention races, transient retries) are logged at WARNING level with wording that primes LLM agents to assume store corruption, causing agents to halt work and waste tokens investigating non-issues

Mid-retry transient-transport retry notices and unpushed-backlog suffixes (including bare `..HEAD` references) escalate worry across concurrent sessions without stating the self-healing contract or normal-load context

Lost-contention outcomes and routine transport retries must be demoted from WARNING/INFO to DEBUG or suppressed entirely under normal load, while policy declines, strict-mode failures, and proven-growing backlogs remain operator-loud (WARNING)

The `unpushed_summary` suffix and backlog reporting must name the tickets branch explicitly, state the self-healing contract in-text, and avoid bare `..HEAD` references that confuse sessions about scope
